description: This file defines the LineReporter class, a custom terminal reporter for test results in the Playwright testing framework. It handles output formatting, test lifecycle events, and error reporting.

classes.name: LineReporter
classes.description: A terminal-based test reporter class that displays test progress, failures, and errors with formatted output.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs starting message.

methods.name: onStdErr
methods.description: Handles standard error output during tests.

methods.name: _dumpToStdio
methods.description: Outputs test output chunks to the appropriate stream, with headers for new tests.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the beginning of a test, updates current test count.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test step, updates display if TTY.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step, updates display if TTY.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles test completion, reports flaky or unexpected tests.

methods.name: _updateLine
methods.description: Updates the current test line in the terminal with test info.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles errors during testing, outputs error messages.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of the test run, outputs final epilogue.
